household.title: Bagpipes, bag made from a sheep's hide.

A wooden tobacco box with a hinged lid. It is roughly rectangular in shape, but the two shorter edges are rounded and convex. The lid is decorated with an incised picture of a man and a woman; the man seems to be wearing a uniform and lapels. The figures are coloured with black, green, and red pigment, and there are green and red spiralled banners on each side, and a circular design in the middle. There is a band of decoration around the sides of the box, and a picture of a man wearing a suit on the bottom. The man is wearing a red hat, and is holding a red and green plant; there are also plants in the upper left and bottom right corner.

Purse decorated with coloured glass beads, with a leather lining, a small internal pocket, a hinged opening framed with metal, and a hinged metal clasp. Both sides have the same design, consisting of Greek script in blue, and a floral motif in green, yellow and blue, all on a white background. The top and base have green, blue and red stripes.

Walking stick, comprising a thick, cylindrical, segmented shaft, possibly of palm wood, with a metal band covering each end. A black tassel, possibly of wool with a fibre binding and ribbon, is tied through metal-lined oval holes near the top of the shaft. The metal band at the bottom is wide; the band at the top is narrow.

A wooden box (.2) containing five cigarettes (.3-7). The box is rectangular, with a hinged lid that is decorated with an incised image of St George slaying a dragon. The picture is coloured with black, red, and green pigment. The sides of the box feature a band of decoration, and the bottom is decorated with a picture of a priest. There are five cigarettes in the box, along with a small amount of loose tobacco that has fallen out of the cigarettes.

masks-ritual.title: Staff comprising a horn handle carved in the form of a S-shaped sea animal, possibly a fish, attached with two metal nails to a long, narrow, curved wooden shaft with a bulbous end. The horn animal is decorated with incised patterns of semicircles and dots, and has a slit mouth with a tongue stained with red pigment.
Mole's paw amulet in metal fitting with suspension loop.

garment.title: A dark blue wool coat with long sleeves and a long body with a full skirt. The coat has a pointed lapel, breast pocket, two side pockets with pointed pocket flaps, which are all trimmed with blue cotton; the collar is covered in black velvet. There are three shell buttons on both sides of the front opening, and no button holes; two shell buttons on both sleeve cuffs. The coat is lined with striped black and grey cloth, possibly brushed cotton; internal pocket on the proper right side.

Tsipune. A man's long sleeveless coat made from black wool, with a pleated back. The front is open and trimmed with a brown braiding, with a wide decorative area of brown braiding at the chest; the arm holes, chest pocket and two side pockets are also trimmed with brown braiding.
A man’s brown leather belt with a rectangular metal buckle and a small purse attached at the buckle end. The purse is fastened with a metal stud.

A short jacket made from black wool, with a brown cotton braided trim. The jacket has long sleeves that are open along the bottom and connected at the cuffs with the brown trim. Internal pockets on both sides.

Dzhibadone. A long sleeved cotton waistcoat or jacket, with a double breasted front with metal hook and eye fastenings. The fabric is blue with cream and red vertical stripes; panels of red and brown fabric have been added to the armpits. There is black trim around the neck, front opening and cuffs, and along the front fastenings. The cuffs are fastened with black glass beads. Inside the jacket is lined with cream cotton.

Kameushu. A long man’s shirt made from cotton with a white, grey and blue check pattern, with zig-zag details. The shirt has long sleeves, a short collar, waist band, and a full pleated skirt section. The shirt is fastened down the front with four shell buttons, and there is pleating either side of the buttons; the cuffs are also fastened with shell buttons.
A pair of navy blue wool leggings, with a brown cotton braid trim. They have a tab with a beige and brown cords attached at the top, and brass metal hook and eye fastenings at the ankles.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of navy, purple, black, white and green with zigzags of bright green and pink. Tied together.

A pair of red leather shoes with upturned toes with large brown wool pom-poms attached. There is a stripe of brown, cream, blue and red threads down the centre of the shoes; the leather has been stitched together with cream and black threads.
A hat, possibly a fez, made from cream colour felt, of cylindrical shape, with a short projection on the top.
Katshula; Kaliposhe. Red fez hat with black tassel. For festive wear.
A cream cotton hat with a flat round top and flaring sides. Decorated with gold silk embroidery in bands of patterns around the sides and a star shape on the top.

A hooded coat or cloak made from un-spun grey wool, with long sleeves with open seams along the the underarms, two side pockets, and fastened by black and white cotton toggle buttons along the front. The edges of the coat are trimmed with white cotton cord, and the front opening is trimmed with black and white cotton cord. Some of the interior seams are possibly secured by felting.
A pair of black leather shoes with pointed toes and block heels. There are metal segments attached to the soles; the inside is line with floral fabric.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in cream wool with pink toes. For festive wear. Tied together.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of navy, green, maroon, blue, white and pink. Tied together.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of navy, blue, pink, green, maroon and white. Tied together.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of navy, blue, brown and maroon. Tied together.

Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of navy, maroon, white, green, purple and pink with bands of stranded decoration. Striped black and white fabric reinforces the heels.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of blue, black, orange, maroon, green and pink. Tied together.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of blue, black, brown, orange, purple and pink. Tied together.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of blue, pink and orange.
Lapudzi. Pair of woollen socks knitted with a ribbed cuff in stripes of navy, blue, purple, orange, maroon and green. Heels reinforced with a piece of woven brown material. Tied together.
A pair of navy blue wool leggings, with a brown cotton braid trim. They have a tab with a navy blue cord attached at the top, and metal hook and eye fastenings at the ankles.

Kameushu. A long man’s shirt made from cotton with a white, grey and blue check pattern, with zig-zag details. The shirt has long sleeves, a short collar, waist band, and a full pleated skirt section. The shirt is fastened down the front with four shell buttons, and there is pleating either side of the buttons; the cuffs are also fastened with shell buttons. The proper right armpit appears to have been repaired with black stitching.

Shirt - A: two long shirts or " kameushu" of cotton print in white and grey check. Pleat on chest and in front of skirt. For everyday use. B: fine, white, linen shirt. More fully pleated in front. For festive occasions. All worn by men

Tsipune. A man's long sleeveless coat made from black wool, with a heavily pleated back. The front is open and trimmed with a brown braiding, with a wide decorative area of brown braiding at the chest; the arm holes, chest pocket and two side pockets are also trimmed with brown braiding. The pleats are stitched together with unspun wool.

jewelry.title: Beaded ornament in the form of a snake, comprising a long, white textile tube decorated with coloured glass beads, with a lozenge-shaped head and loops of white and blue beads for the tail. The head is black with white eyes, and has white, blue-green and beige chevrons on the underside. The body has blue, red, black, white, pink, yellow, and beige circles on a green background on one side, and beige on the underside.

Beaded necklace, comprising a long, white textile tube decorated with red, blue and white glass beads arranged in a zigzag pattern. One end has a loop in red, white and blue, the other end has a bulbous yellow ornament with loops of yellow and blue beads. Loops of blue beads are attached at three points along the tube.

Beaded ornament in the form of a snake, comprising a long, red textile tube decorated with coloured glass beads, with a lozenge-shaped head and loops of pink, blue, black and white beads for the tail. The head is green with white eyes, and has pink, blue and colourless chevrons on the underside. The body has blue-green, beige, blue, colourless, red, and pink circles on a green background on one side, and yellow on the underside.

Beaded necklace, comprising a tubular loop decorated with coloured glass beads, with a hanging triangular ornament at the bottom. The tube has diagonal stripes in blue-green, yellow, blue, and green, with a multicoloured section on one side. Loops of blue, green, black, yellow, and red are attached at intervals around the tube. The hanging ornament has a triangular pattern in yellow, blue, green, and black, with hanging loops of green.

arms.title: A folding pocket knife with a black handle made of horn, carved in the form of a dragon. Red pigment has been used to highlight the dragon's mouth and eyes. The blade is metal and has a curved cutting edge and a point along the blade back. There is a star engraved on one side of the blade, and a fish and "BAEINIKI" [sic] on the other. There is a suspension ring attached to the end of the blade.

other.title: A pair of men’s white linen drawers, with short legs and a draw string waistband.

A pair of red, black and white garters woven into long rectangular bands with loops and one end, and long plaited ties with tassels ends at the other. Woven with a background and a central row of red, with white triangles along either side.
A pair of men’s white linen drawers, with short legs and a draw string waistband. Small area of red stitching on the waistband.
A long, rectangular sash of black wool, with tassels along the two short edges.
A rectangular black silk sash made from two panels stitched together in the middle, with a blue trefoil brocade design across the fabric. Hemmed along three edges.

A waistcoat with an open front fastened with four toggles of black cord at the bottom and one at the neck. Made from blue cotton cloth striped with yellow vertical lines, with red and purple velvet panels down the front, overlaid with decorative black braiding. The arm holes and the bottom are trimmed with black cotton; the inside is lined with white cotton across the body and black and blue floral silk along the edges.

A pair of red, black and white garters woven into long rectangular bands with loops and one end, and long plaited ties with tassels ends at the other. Woven with a central row of red and black chevrons, with white triangles along either side and red along the edges.
A pair black garters woven into long rectangular bands with loops and one end, and long plaited ties with tassels ends at the other.
